queries: WITH f AS (SELECT zoneref, traitcount, CAST(traitcount AS REAL) / SUM(traitcount) OVER () AS share FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL), g AS (SELECT zoneref, traitcount, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM f) SELECT zoneref AS site_code, traitcount AS feature_count, share, share - avg_share AS margin_above_average FROM g WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Records with NULL traitcount are excluded before computing the total and the average share, so the average is taken over records with a non-null count (it equals 1/N).

Each scanfeatures row is treated separately, so a site code can appear more than once. Share is the row's traitcount divided by the sum of traitcount over the non-null rows, as a fraction (not a percent) and unrounded.

assumptions.assumption: Share is expressed as a fraction (traitcount divided by the sum of non-null traitcount), not multiplied by 100. Ranking is unaffected by this choice.
The average share is the mean of the per-record shares over records with non-null traitcount. This equals 1 divided by the number of such records.
Each scanfeatures row is treated separately, so a site code can appear more than once. Rows tied on margin are returned in arbitrary order.

responses.sql: WITH f AS (SELECT zoneref, traitcount FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL), s AS (SELECT zoneref, traitcount, traitcount * 1.0 / SUM(traitcount) OVER () AS share FROM f), a AS (SELECT zoneref, traitcount, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT zoneref AS site_code, traitcount AS feature_count, share, share - avg_share AS margin_above_average FROM a WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A record's share is its traitcount divided by the sum of traitcount over all scanfeatures records with a non-null traitcount. The average share is the mean of those shares across the same records, which equals 1/N. Zero counts stay in as valid records.
Each scanfeatures record is kept separate, so a site code can appear more than once. Ties at the 10th place are cut arbitrarily by LIMIT 10.
Shares are fractions (0 to 1), not percentages, and are unrounded.
